title: a channel-bound producer + consumer whose kafka broker is down while the backend boots
note: the boot gate (test/support/fakes/broker-sidecar.mjs) refuses every broker connection until the backend has tried one, so a consumer that connects once at init and gives up fails the boot; a retrying one boots and carries on.

python.//: The kafka client starts inside the startup path with no retry; a broker that is down while the app boots fails the startup.
python.reason: the python kafka channel client connects once at startup and fails it when the broker is down

elixir.//: The kafka consumer connects synchronously in `init`; the boot gate's down-at-boot broker makes it fail, and the app does not start.
elixir.reason: the Elixir channel consumer connects in init and crashes the boot when the broker is down
